## Description

Brief summary of the changes proposed in this Pull Request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Specification change / clarification (`docs/`)
- [ ] Schema update (`schemas/`)
- [ ] OpenAPI update (`api/`)
- [ ] Architectural Decision Record (`docs/adr/`)
- [ ] Test suite enhancement (`tests/`)
- [ ] Documentation / metadata improvement

## Quality Checklist

- [ ] All automated tests pass (`bun test`).
- [ ] If JSON schemas were modified, corresponding `examples/` are updated and validate.
- [ ] If OpenAPI was modified, syntax and schema references are valid.
- [ ] Cryptographic checksums verified or updated if normative specs changed (`bun run validate:checksums`).
- [ ] Does not contain secrets, private tokens, or sensitive credentials.
- [ ] Adheres to the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/agent-auth-protocol/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
